[SWS_UCM_CONSTR_00003] Exclusive use of Vehicle Driver Interface
⌈
Software
Integrator shall ensure that only one
Adaptive Application
is using the
UCM
Master
's Vehicle Driver Interface.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00035, RS_UCM_00037)
For example, the integrator may restrict the access of Vehicle Driver Interface from
UCM Master
by configuring the Identity and Access Management functional cluster
accordingly.
